protocol_amendment.reason: Clarified terminal arm order and independently custodied release events before any reserved execution.

gates.command: uv run ruff check scripts/plan_confirmatory.py scripts/analyze_confirmatory.py scripts/preflight_assets.py scripts/check_study_signature.py scripts/audit_run_receipts.py tests/test_plan_confirmatory.py tests/test_analyze_confirmatory.py tests/test_preflight_assets.py tests/test_check_study_signature.py tests/test_audit_run_receipts.py

negative_controls: Rehashed and still balanced arm positions that differ from the planner seed are rejected.
Rehashed changes to planner limits are rejected.
Altered assets, purpose, challenge message, trust key, or signature are rejected by the study-signature checks.
A later arm started before the prior arm's retry is terminal is reported as a receipt violation.
A prior arm with only an unresolved external failure cannot authorize the next arm.
Completed calls with zero declared active time and inverted starts are reported as receipt violations.
not_performed: No genuine study signature or independently custodied preregistration and release-event chain.
No reserved matrix, provider executions, authenticated telemetry, original trace-byte audit, or invoice reconciliation.
No independent double-blind quality ratings, human approval of value decisions, authorized resource budget, or field impact observation.
